A flag stored before pthread_join is not a still-joinable OS join error. The retained lifecycle-join-recovery stdout is only the banner line. Those PASS receipts stay unclosed. The live milestone text is 8/12.

Campaign repair-9-12 run lifecycle-join-os-1 shrunk from 11 processors to 1. ##current-vm-resize returned 0, the count became 1, reopen returned 0, and the count returned to 11. ___lifecycle_join_os_errno returned 0. The built resize path calls ___thread_join and stores ___ERRNO_FROM_ERR_CODE only in the not-NO_ERR branch, then joins once more and transfers only after that second call returns ___NO_ERR with handler_quiet and a stored errno other than 22. This run took the first-call ___NO_ERR path. No still-joinable OS join error was recorded. This witness is not the ___LW_REFUSED receipt. Milestone stays 8/12.

The first stdlib stopped in optimizer-resolve-class because time.ssi had no time.ssxi.ss. The later clean stdlib wrote time.ssxi.ss and declare-class for std/time/time#ExactTime::t. That removed this particular unknown class. It is not a TYPEID witness.

The lldb rerun did not stop in a signal. gxi exited 70 with heap overflow after writing an #f64 vector where the stock compiler writes a gensym. Refusing every non-symbol from identifier-symbol then stopped stdlib at sync/spinlock.ss:14 with detail #f, because #f is an absent identifier. #f must be returned. A vector still must not be emitted. This is not an exclusive ##wr-structure TYPEID witness and not a join recovery.

On this Darwin host a two-thread join cycle returns EDEADLK (11) to owner A while worker W is still joinable. A's second pthread_join of W, still by A, returns 11 again. W's pthread_join of A returns 0 only after A exits. A different thread then joins W and gets 0. This is the platform cycle, not ___vm_resize_pstate. The resize campaign lifecycle-join-os-1 remains DENY because its first ___thread_join returned ___NO_ERR. Milestone stays 8/12.

The error branch stores a non-EINVAL errno from the ___thread_join that just returned and leaves the worker pending. It does not call ___thread_join again in that branch. Campaign lifecycle-join-later-1 is DENY, exit 2. Shrink 11 to 1 returned 0, reopen returned 0, and ___lifecycle_join_os_errno returned 0. The first join was ___NO_ERR, so the pending branch did not run. Milestone stays 8/12.

The resize ___thread_join runs after barrier_sync_op(OP_SET_PROCESSOR_COUNT). The retiring processor stores handler_quiet and calls ___thread_exit. pthread_join waits for that exit and returns 0, so ___thread_join returns ___NO_ERR and the pending branch does not run. This host has no pthread_tryjoin_np. EDEADLK occurs when the target is inside pthread_join of the caller, and the same owner's next pthread_join stays 11. This shrink does not create that cycle. Processor 0 now calls recover_retired_processors once when a later resize finds pending_join_count nonzero, then every processor returns. Campaign lifecycle-join-wait-2 is DENY, exit 2, stdout the no-error line and (11 0 1 0 11 0). Milestone stays 8/12.

Owner A's pthread_join of W returns 11 while W is inside pthread_join of A. An immediate second pthread_join also returns 11. pthread_cancel of W returns 0, and after that cancellation takes effect A's pthread_join of W returns 0. pthread_join does not return EINTR here. The resize path never enters this cycle: its ___thread_join waits for ___thread_exit and returns ___NO_ERR. Milestone stays 8/12.
